items.title: Regular polygon angles
items.prompt: A regular polygon has an interior angle five times its exterior angle. Which polygon is it?
steps: An interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle add to 180°. If the exterior angle is e, then 5e + e = 180°, so e = 30°.
The exterior angles total 360°. Therefore the polygon has 360/30 = 12 sides, making it a dodecagon.

items.title: Rearranging a rational formula
items.prompt: Rearrange y = (3x − 9c)/(4x + 5d) to make x the subject, where the required denominators are nonzero.
steps: Collect the terms containing x: 4xy − 3x = −9c − 5dy. Factor to obtain x(4y − 3) = −(9c + 5dy).
Divide by 4y − 3: x = −(9c + 5dy)/(4y − 3). The original expression requires 4x + 5d ≠ 0, and this rearrangement requires 4y − 3 ≠ 0.

items.title: Solving a linear inequality
items.prompt: Find the values of x satisfying 3(x − 1) ≤ 2(x − 3).
steps: Subtract 2x from both sides, then add 3: x ≤ −3. The inequality direction stays the same because these steps do not multiply or divide by a negative number.
At x = −3 both sides equal −12, so the boundary value is included.
